paragraphs.source_en: Vienna’s defenders—‘the herd of rabid pigs destined to burn in the eternal flames of Hell’, as the Ottomans called them—chose to fight the ‘gazis of Islam’ rather than surrender or convert.* No matter the high mindedness of the grand vizier, the twomonth siege was a disaster for the Ottomans. Ottoman soldiers were lambasted by contemporary chroniclers for drinking wine and not giving up fornicating and pederasty, despite the fact that the siege occurred during the holy months of Rajab, Shaban, and Ramadan.° Bad omens abounded. Kara Mustafa Pasha’s Istanbul palace burned to the ground in his absence. Mehmed IV’s mother Hatice Turhan passed away.
